scripts.bootstrap: bun run setup:app && bun run setup:catalog
scripts.test: bun run test:web && bun run test:api
scripts.docker:up: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker up -d
scripts.docker:down: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker down
scripts.docker:restart: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker restart
scripts.docker:logs: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker logs -f
scripts.docker:ps: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker ps
scripts.docker:pull: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker pull
scripts.docker:build: bunx dotenvx run -f docker/.env -- docker compose --env-file docker/.env.example -f docker/docker-compose.yml --project-directory docker build
scripts.setup:app: bun run docker:up && bun run db:migrate
scripts.catalog:sync: bun run catalog:export && bun run catalog:import && bun run catalog:smoke
